# Nown S.I.T.E.S

> Zero-dependency website framework. Native HTML, native CSS, vanilla JS — no build
> step, no package manager. A site is a "plate" (background + grid) hosting modular
> "tiles". Copy, theme and assets are data (content.json), editable in an admin
> dashboard. S.I.T.E.S = Seamlessly Integrated Technology Enabling Success.

Start here: AGENTS.md — the operating manual (rules, workflow, contracts, checklist).
Then docs/SPEC.md — the normative standard (MUST/SHOULD, conformance levels L1–L4).

## Two machines / two agent harnesses

## Build a site (workflow)
- docs/INTAKE-FORM.md — gather everything needed (DIY, agency, or agent)
- docs/BLUEPRINT-FORMAT.md — authoring format (markdown, one section per tile)
- tools/blueprint.mjs — compile blueprint.md → content.json
- tools/check-site.mjs — static linter: pages vs content file, links, assets (no browser)
- docs/MODULE-SPEC.md — tile naming/CSS/JS/data contracts + catalog + checklist
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — plate/tile model, tokens, grid math, container queries

## Runtime contracts
- docs/CONTENT-MODEL.md — content file, admin dashboard, storage adapters
- docs/THEME-ENGINE.md — light/dark palettes, switcher, admin-editable tokens
- docs/ASSETS.md — images: repo assets or Firebase Storage token URLs
- docs/INTEGRATIONS.md — blocks/adapters/recipes: auth, payments, forms, AI
- docs/DEPLOYMENT.md — Firebase default stack, rules, alternatives

## Machine-readable
- ai-skill/sites-schema.json — JSON Schema for the site manifest / content file
- ai-skill/prompt-instructions.md — drop-in system prompt for any agent
- src/js/tile-registry.js — the editable fields per tile type

## Build it by hand (no AI, no build step)
- templates/plate.html — the starter page: copy it and paste tiles into <main>
- templates/TILE-KIT.md — every tile's markup + content entry, ready to copy
- templates/README.md — the four-step loop, deploy steps, and a guide for people
  coming from drag-and-drop website builders

## The framework's own website (self-referential demo)
- site/public/index.html — the framework site, built with the framework
- site/public/tiles.html — the tile gallery: every tile rendered live from one content file
- site/public/content.json — the site's content/theme/assets
- site/blueprint.md — its authoring source
- tools/sync-site-runtime.sh — copy src/ into the site's public dir

## Reference implementation
- src/css/nown-plate.css — design tokens, plate, auto-fit grid, theming
- src/css/nown-tiles.css — core tile styles
- src/js/sites.js — tile init registry
- src/js/sites-content.js — binder: draws copy from the content file
- src/js/sites-theme.js — theme engine
- src/js/sites-assets.js — asset adapters
- src/js/sites-adapters.js — storage adapters (local/git/firebase)
- src/js/sites-admin.js — admin dashboard
- src/modules/**/*.html — copy-able tile markup
- examples/prototype-template.html — a full working page
- examples/nowndigital.blueprint.md + .content.json — a complete worked example

## Optional
- docs/AI-HARNESS.md — how AI agents should generate S.I.T.E.S sites
- docs/ROADMAP.md — protocol site + programmatic/full builders (long-term)
